label: Trends in incidence of tick bites and physician-reported early and late Lyme borreliosis in the Netherlands.
summary: Lyme borreliosis (LB) is a prevalent vector-borne disease in Europe. Untreated, it can cause severe complications, with some patients experiencing persistent symptoms post-treatment. In the Netherlands, tick bite consultations and erythema migrans (EM) diagnoses tripled from 1994 to 2009, but tick bite consultations declined and EM diagnoses stabilized in 2014.
